description: This file defines a JavaScript/TypeScript SDK for embedding and interacting with Superset dashboards via iframes, including functions for mounting dashboards, handling tokens, messaging, and theming.

classes.name: EmbeddedDashboard
classes.description: Interface providing methods to interact with an embedded Superset dashboard, such as retrieving size, permalink, active tabs, data masks, chart states, and theme settings.

methods.name: embedDashboard
methods.description: Embeds a Superset dashboard into a specified DOM element using an iframe, sets up messaging, token refresh, and provides an API for interaction.
